steps: Shake the dressing in a jar: 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 60 ml fish sauce, 60 ml canola oil, 1 tbsp sugar, the minced garlic and 2 tsp finely minced red chilli. Set aside 10 minutes.
Finely shred the napa cabbage. Slice the red onion very thinly, cut the bell pepper into thin batons, deseed and slice the cucumbers into half moons, and julienne the carrot.
Combine all the salad vegetables in a large bowl with the chicken, mint and coriander leaves.
Add half the dressing and toss well. Set aside 5 minutes so it softens slightly.
Toss again just before serving and add the remaining dressing to taste.
Sprinkle generously with the chopped roasted peanuts and serve.
